The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Puts the point first: the change cannot be merged yet because an automatic check failed
- Explains PR, CI, race condition and token in plain words before relying on them
- Keeps the cause accurate and does not drop the fact that the failure comes from two things getting in each other's way

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
